content_sections.text: Maximum age is 45 years for all posts. Age relaxation: 05 years for SC/ ST candidates and 3 years for OBC Candidates. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.text: As per 7th CPC pay matrix level 11 (Rs 67,700/ - Rs 2,08,700/ -) and other admissible allowances per month.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Resident posts at ABGH?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The interview is scheduled for 27th August 2026. Candidates should report at the specified time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/DNB/DIPLOMA or equivalent in the concerned stream) or have 03 years of experience as a Junior Resident, with at least 02 years in the concerned department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST (05 years) and OBC (3 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident Doctors at ABGH?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for Senior Resident (SR) Doctors posts across various specializations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The salary is as per the 7th CPC pay matrix level 11, ranging from Rs 67,700/- to Rs 2,08,700/- per month, along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ABGH Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Room No. 304, Establishment Branch, 3rd floor, ABGH hospital, Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to report between 09:30 A.M. to 11:00 A.M. on the day of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for these Senior Resident posts.
